summary: Cementos Pacasmayo S.A.A. filed a 6-K disclosing that Inversiones ASPI S.A., a Holcim Ltd. subsidiary acting jointly and severally with Holcim, advanced its public tender offer for the Company's common voting shares on November 2, 2026. The Offeror filed an SMV response curing Official Letter No. 5476-2026-SMV/11.1 observations, with a revised prospectus and offer notice, and filed Amendment No. 1 to the Schedule TO and Rule 13e-3 statement with an Amended and Restated Offer to Purchase for the concurrent US offer covering shares and ADSs. BBVA Bolsa is intermediation agent; Georgeson is US information agent. No price, stake, premium or dates are stated in the excerpt; watch SMV approval, US offer expiry, and tender conditions.
